item.title: Fire Breaks Out At 5-Story Building
item.description: Firefighters rescued 11 people -- including three who were hanging out of upper-floor windows -- after responding to a three-alarm blaze at a five-story apartment building near the corner of Chapel Street and Winthrop Avenue midday Tuesday.
